# situation: the job sets an env key DATABASE=URL, meant as the variable
#   DATABASE_URL.
# reason: no name of an environment variable can have =: the step gets no
#   variable DATABASE_URL, and the runner sets the variable DATABASE to
#   URL=postgres://db instead.
on: workflow_call
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      DATABASE=URL: postgres://db
    steps:
      - run: ./test.sh
